notes: Issue #60 built the stay researcher, the first worker agent. Its body grew from 254 words at creation on 2026-10-19 to 2,794 words, over 31 versions, all before the PR opened on 2026-10-28; nothing was added after. Settled questions take most of the words (about 2,250), led by the 884-word budget tier answer (I60-10); the Do and Done when items are about 350 words. The struck-out answers split two ways. Some are the task itself: the meal default (I60-9), how a worker searches (inside I60-10), and the candidate fields (I60-13, I60-14), which Do item I60-17 points to. Others are history, moved to other issues or already done (I60-6, I60-7, I60-8, I60-11, I60-12). The PR description copied every Do and Done when item word for word (P207-d1 to d12), including a struck item (d12), and added only results (P207-d13 to d20). The decisions comment held 13 decisions, and 11 of them say which spec section they went into (P207-c1 to c11, c13); the ones that don't are about code or the drafted brief outline (c12, c14 to c20). It also held the worker brief outline for review, an example brief, and set-asides that were moved into #61's and #64's Do. Results all went in the PR description, none in issue comments. Surprising: the decisions comment opens by saying the decisions were made without Joe, though the issue said 'Settled in: chat' (P207-c0). I60-15's answer was written into the body from the PR three minutes before the PR opened. P207-c8 shows a settled answer that told someone to write it into two specs had not been written in until this PR.
